answer: The ripple index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the cipher queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 476 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pigment. The deposit is 20 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
